ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Rampage.cs:40-43) == cost 1 / ATTACK / UNCOMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(9m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new DynamicVar("Increase", 5m)` (Rampage.cs:18-22) == both numbers, both declared, and `_increase` is in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` so `magic_number` surfaces it.

OnPlay.rationale: `await DamageCmd.Attack(DynamicVars.Damage.BaseValue)...Execute()` then `DynamicVars.Damage.BaseValue += DynamicVars["Increase"].BaseValue` (Rampage.cs:48-52) == `DamageCmd.deal(...)` then `self._damage += self._increase`. The order is load-bearing on both sides -- THIS play uses the pre-increment damage -- and the growth persists on the card instance for the rest of the combat, which the sim's docstring states explicitly.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars["Increase"].UpgradeValueBy(4m)` (Rampage.cs:63) == `self._increase += 4` (5 -> 9). The BASE damage stays 9 when upgraded on both sides -- only the growth rate changes, which is the easy one to get backwards.

AfterDowngraded.maps_to: NOT PORTED -- RampageCard has no downgrade hook, so `downgrade()` DESTROYS the accumulated damage (rampage.py)
AfterDowngraded.issue: `AfterDowngraded()` calls base and then `DynamicVars.Damage.BaseValue += ExtraDamageFromPlays` (Rampage.cs:55-59), re-adding everything this Rampage has accumulated from its own plays after `DowngradeInternal` rebuilt the damage var from canonical (CardModel.cs:2140). C# tracks the total in a private field for exactly this reason, and says so: "Required so we can restore the extra damage amount after a downgrade (ie Magiknight)" (Rampage.cs:24-26). The sim accumulates into `_damage` directly (rampage.py:117) and tracks nothing, so `Card.downgrade`'s `_init_vars` rebuild (cards/base.py:150-165) resets `_damage` to 9 and the accumulation is lost. Observable: play an upgraded Rampage three times (9 -> 18 -> 27 -> 36), then have it downgraded -- the game keeps 9 + 27 accumulated = 36, the sim drops to 9. LIVE via `powers.py:3171` (DampenPower downgrades every upgraded card in AllCards IN COMBAT, which is exactly when the accumulation exists) and also `events/reflections.py:40` / `events/welcome_to_wongos.py:90`. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/maul's AfterDowngraded entry (rule 3) -- these two cards are the pool's only `AfterDowngraded` overrides, and both are unported. Not caught by `card_probes.py downgrade`, which compares a FRESH card against upgrade+downgrade and so never sees the accumulation.

guards.rationale: AnyEnemy cards always resolve a target; `ctx.resolve_target(target_idx)` is the equivalent contract.
